title: Restore My Joy
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Restore My Joy | Repentance, Cleansing from Sin, Conviction, and Obedience - Psalm v51:1-12

Psalm v51:1-12 brings us into the broken heart of David as he cries for mercy, cleansing, and renewal after sin. We are reminded that sin is never small. It stains the soul, troubles the mind, burdens the heart, and robs us of the joy God gives to His obedient children. Yet the same God who convicts also invites us to come clean before Him and ask, _Create in me a clean heart, O God_.

There is hope for every repentant sinner because God's mercy is greater than our failure. When we stop excusing sin and confess it before the Lord, He restores what disobedience has damaged. Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation becomes the cry of every believer who longs to walk closely with God again. In the end, our deepest needs are answered in Jesus Christ, who bore our sin at the cross and rose again so we can be forgiven, cleansed, and given eternal life.
